arguments.command: PYTHONPATH=host:consumer python -m pytest -q host/tests/test_funcutils* host/tests/test_dictutils.py host/tests/test_iterutils.py host/tests/test_setutils.py consumer/glom/test

PYTHONPATH=host:consumer python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from boltons.funcutils import FunctionBuilder, inspect_formatargspec, formatargandannotation
from boltons.dictutils import OneToOne
from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet, complement
from boltons.iterutils import unique
from glom import glom, Auto, Fill, T, S, Check, Let, Iter, First, Inspect, Literal, Coalesce

def func(a:int=1,*args:float,k:str='x',**kw:dict)->bool: return a,k
with warnings.catch_warnings():
 warnings.simplefilter('error')
 fb=FunctionBuilder.from_func(func)
 assert fb.get_defaults_dict()=={'a':1,'k':'x'}
 assert fb.get_sig_str() == "(a: int, *args: float, k: str, **kw: dict) -> bool",fb.get_sig_str()
 assert fb.get_func()() is None
 assert inspect_formatargspec(['a'], defaults=[1],kwonlyargs=['b'],kwonlydefaults={'b':2})=='(a=1, *, b=2)'
 assert formatargandannotation('a', {'a':int})=='a: int'
o=OneToOne([('a',1),('b',1),('c',2)])
assert list(o.items())==[('a',1),('b',1),('c',2)]
assert o.inv[1]=='b'
del o['b']; assert o.inv[1]=='a'
assert o.pop('a')==1 and 1 not in o.inv
o.update(iter([('x',4),('y',5)]));o.update();o.update(z=6)
assert unique([2,1,2,3,1])==[2,1,3]
assert set({1,2,3} - IndexedSet([2,4]))=={1,3}
s=IndexedSet([1,2,3,4]);s.difference_update({1,2},{3});assert s=={4}
for a in [set(),{1},{1,2},frozenset({1,2})]:
 for b in [set(),{1},{2,3}]:
  assert a-complement(b)==a&b
  assert a-complement(complement(b))==a-b
assert glom({'a':3}, Fill({'answer':T['a'], 'literal':'a'}))=={'answer':3,'literal':'a'}
assert glom({'a':3}, Fill((Auto('a'), 'literal', T['a'])))==(3,'literal',3)
assert glom({'a':3}, (Let(x='a'), {'x': S['x'], 'a':'a'}))=={'x':3,'a':3}
assert glom([1,2,3,4],Iter().filter(lambda x:x%2).map(lambda x:x*10).all())==[10,30]
assert glom(range(7),Iter().dropwhile(lambda x:x<2).chunked(2).all())==[[2,3],[4,5],[6]]
assert glom([[0,1],[2,3]],Iter().flatten().first())==1
assert glom([0,1,2],First(Check(validate=lambda x:x>1)))==2
assert glom([],Iter().first(default='empty'))=='empty'
assert glom({'a':{'b':2}}, Inspect('a.b',recursive=True,echo=False))==2
assert glom([{'a':1},{'a':2}],Inspect(['a'],recursive=True,echo=False))==[1,2]
assert glom([1,2],[(Let(x=T),S['x'])])==[1,2]
print('requirement-level smoke checks passed')
PY
